title: Rolling Thunder
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 6 "pass through to an ocean wave - robins by left in the center, neighbors by right on the sides larks cross to the other side and give right hand to same neighbor · ocean-wave": a dancer has to move 1.27 m in one beat, faster than a walk.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.

figures.text: robins allemande right 1½ go to partner
larks allemande left 1½ or cross left for a longer swing
